entry.title: New: BILL008(24) (Honolulu) — PUBLISH
entry.content:
RELATING TO COMMUNITY WORKFORCE AGREEMENTS.

Amends definitions of "Covered Project," "Maintenance," and "Operation" with respect to Community Workforce Agreements to include certain large-scale public works projects involving existing structures, buildings, facilities, or infrastructure.

Latest action: Final reading notice published in the Honolulu Star-Advertiser.
